title: API Migration Manifest
description: Machine-readable description of an API change and how to migrate code that uses it. The core asset of the apimigrate product: a vendor ships these, or apimigrate curates them, and customers' codebases are scanned against them.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest format itself.

title.description: Human-readable change title, e.g. 'Amount fields migrated from integer cents to decimal dollars'.

severity.description: Impact class. 'breaking' means the old usage stops working; 'deprecation' means it warns but still works; 'feature' is additive.

changedAt.description: Date the change takes effect, ISO 8601.

references.description: Links to the vendor changelog or migration guide.

type.description: Kind of change. The scanner engine treats these as queryable patterns.

description.description: What changed, for humans and for the PR description.

name.description: Function or method name to match, e.g. 'stripe.charges.create' (dotted) or 'createCharge'.

object.description: Optional receiver object name for method calls, e.g. 'stripe'.

field.description: Match object property access or construction.

parameter.description: Match a call site passing this parameter.

minVersion.description: Minimum required version; matches imports below this.

match.description: At least one match pattern; the scanner returns a hit when a pattern matches.

fix.description: Optional mechanical fix to apply. If absent, the change is report-only.

explain.description: Human explanation of the fix, used in the PR body.
